stories.new_fact: Judge Timothy Kelly issued a preliminary injunction preserving CNN, MS NOW and Politico hard-pass access while the lawsuit proceeds.
stories.new_takeaway: White House credentialing is being treated as operating infrastructure subject to due process and viewpoint limits.
stories.why_now: The temporary order was expiring Tuesday and the judge extended protection late Tuesday.
stories.previous_coverage: No direct prior segment; October 7 covered ABC/FCC licensing, a different press/regulator conflict.
stories.uncertainty: Appeal posture, final merits ruling and any narrowed access policy remain unresolved.
stories.watch: Justice Department appeal, narrowed credential policy or a merits schedule.

stories.new_fact: More than a dozen Muslim organizations held the first Columbus Muslim Voter Day near the Franklin County Board of Elections and plan a repeat on October 24.
stories.new_takeaway: The local access issue is the full path to voting: trust, transportation, ID, safety perceptions and community translation.
stories.why_now: The first event occurred Monday during early voting and the next event has a dated October 24 trigger.
stories.previous_coverage: No prior coverage in the seven-episode window.
stories.uncertainty: Turnout impact and whether the model repeats beyond one community are not yet known.
stories.watch: October 24 repeat event and early-vote turnout patterns around Morse Road.

stories.new_fact: FirstClose and Cotality launched a deeper integration for home-equity origination from application and automated decisioning through valuation, title, closing and funding.
stories.new_takeaway: The operational test is whether a second-lien workflow can shorten cycle time without hiding title, valuation or borrower-communication exceptions.
stories.why_now: The primary announcement was dated October 12 and reported October 13.
stories.previous_coverage: Prior lending segments covered UAD, Fannie guide changes, FHA score implementation and MPF VA refinance delivery; this is a new home-equity workflow story.
stories.uncertainty: No live-client average close times, exception rates, title outcomes or pricing were disclosed.
stories.watch: FirstClose or Cotality live-client close-time data, exception handling detail or adoption disclosure.

stories.new_fact: TD announced agentic AI for mortgage funding and discharge after an earlier pre-adjudication tool reportedly cut average processing time from 15 hours to less than three minutes.
stories.new_takeaway: Banks are moving AI into document assembly and verification, making correction-rate measurement and human approval logs the key control.
stories.why_now: TD announced the new capabilities on October 13.
stories.previous_coverage: No TD row or mortgage-funding/discharge AI segment appeared in the prior seven scripts.
stories.uncertainty: Volumes, error rates, costs, correction rates and staffing changes for the new tools were not disclosed.
stories.watch: TD disclosure of volumes, correction rates, funding/discharge defects or customer timing outcomes.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Added TD Bank Group / Real Estate Secured Lending mortgage funding and discharge agentic AI as production lane 4, with company-reported time metrics and missing quality metrics.

stories.new_fact: Google published fresh Gemini 4 Argon safety evidence, including 12 of 12 simulated cyberattack scenarios solved and new monitoring claims.
stories.new_takeaway: Safety telemetry is now a buying requirement for frontier agents because stronger models can both solve harder cyber tasks and attempt boundary workarounds.
stories.why_now: Google posted the safety update and updated the model card on October 13.
stories.previous_coverage: October 1 and October 2 covered Argon's launch and third-party comparison page; this segment uses a new safety report and model-card update.
stories.uncertainty: The figures are lab-reported and need independent workflow replication.
stories.watch: Independent cyber, bio-safety or prompt-injection replication of the Argon safety claims.
stories.frontier_bar: Safety and security finding plus agent/tool-use control evidence.

stories.new_fact: AP reported economists surveyed by FactSet expect September CPI at 3.6 percent year over year and 0.6 percent month over month.
stories.new_takeaway: The market issue is whether inflation changes the Fed path that feeds Treasury yields, mortgage sheets and local borrowing costs.
stories.why_now: The Labor Department report is due Wednesday morning.
stories.previous_coverage: Prior markets segments discussed oil, bank earnings and rates, but not this CPI release setup.
stories.uncertainty: The actual CPI print was not yet released at cutoff.
stories.watch: Wednesday CPI print and Fed reaction before the October 27-28 meeting.

stories.new_fact: NWS forecast called for showers and thunderstorms Wednesday with a high near 82 and around an 80 percent daytime precipitation chance.
stories.new_takeaway: The useful local action is to treat warmth as a storm-day setup, not as a dry-day signal.
stories.why_now: The forecast applies to today's commute and outdoor planning.
stories.previous_coverage: Routine weather is included daily but not counted toward freshness.
stories.uncertainty: Thunderstorm timing and exact rainfall vary by location.
stories.watch: NWS updates on thunderstorm timing and rainfall amounts.
